## Cohort 02 is frozen

The condition-blind review of **P04, P05, P08, P12 and P17** is complete and frozen at **2026-11-01 10:11:06 UTC**. I personally inspected their original captures and exercised the representative core workflows in disposable copies. All preview servers I started have been stopped.

**Cohort 01 remains unchanged.** Its immutable file hashes were verified, and all eight earlier product records were preserved when the five new records were appended. The cumulative record now contains **13 products**. No condition mapping was received and no comparator was repaired.

### Frozen judgments

| Product | Task | Judgment | Main finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P04** | T2 conversation | Satisfactory in the exercised scope | Attachment disclosure, stable manual reading position, return to latest, Stop-focus recovery and failure/retry worked. |
| **P05** | T1 settings | Core supported, with a narrow-hierarchy caveat | Long bilingual values wrap readably and persistence/recovery worked. Expanded navigation pushes primary editing far down the narrow layout. |
| **P08** | T4 bounded toast integration | Satisfactory within the settled bounded scope | The native toast preserves the selected source shell, failed-snapshot retry, newer drafts, validation feedback and focus recovery. |
| **P12** | T3 research wiki | Satisfactory in the exercised scope, with explicit caveats | The editorial paper/serif direction supports native reading and editing. Disk persistence was verified. Narrow tables require local panning, and reduced motion retains a brief transition. |
| **P17** | T2 conversation | Core supported; keyboard-focus revision required | Stop ends the stream, but keyboard activation loses focus to the page body. The targeted run required 12 Tabs to reach the composer. |

The full reasoning and within-task comparisons are in [BLIND-REVIEW-COHORT-02.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/BLIND-REVIEW-COHORT-02.md).

### Material findings

**P17’s Stop-focus continuity remains the functional revision.** In the primary run, Stop ended generation and the response text stabilized, while focus remained on `BODY` at the first observation and around 1.1 and 1.6 seconds afterward. A separate run reproduced the loss. Tab restarted through other controls, and the composer was reached on the **12th Tab**; a keyboard follow-up could then be sent. A separately retained repair should restore the appropriate composer focus without disturbing reading position. The exact observations are preserved in the [Stop/Tab follow-up](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/evidence/behavior-stop-focus-cohort02-001/P17.json).

P17’s **Return to latest worked**: the bottom gap stayed at zero at all three samples across approximately 1.5 seconds of continued streaming. P04 also reached and followed the latest content, and its keyboard Stop restored composer focus by the first 100 ms observation. These findings remain separate from the P17 focus defect.

**P05 resolves representative long-value clipping, but its narrow hierarchy remains weak.** The name and organization fields wrapped the mixed-language value within 330 px of visible width. At 390×844, however, the name field began around **y=765**, with organization around **y=910.5**, after the expanded navigation. Saving a submitted snapshot while preserving later edits, failure preservation, retry, validation focus and reload persistence all worked. The caveat concerns the prominence of the primary task at narrow width.

**P12’s table is recoverable through local panning.** Its approximately 483 px-wide ledger table sits inside a 318 px-wide horizontal scroll region. An actual horizontal wheel gesture exposed the complete rightmost “Does not establish” column while the document stayed within the 390 px viewport. The initial view gives limited explicit notice that more columns exist; keyboard and physical-touch panning remain unverified.

P12’s native bilingual edits were confirmed in the saved file and after reload; cancelling a subsequent draft preserved those edits. Native palette and Simplified Chinese UI selection also worked. The motion follow-up established that the sidebar transition changes from **400 ms normally to 150 ms under reduced motion**. Intermediate positions still occur, so the frozen judgment explicitly retains that limitation. These findings are documented in the [table and motion follow-up](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/e1cfe6e447ee/ui-study/independent-review-recovery/evidence/behavior-wiki-narrow-cohort02-001/P12.json).

**P08 met its distinct T4 retry contract.** Retry saved the failed snapshot while retaining a newer draft in the form and continuing to identify that draft as unsaved. Pending Save retained focus; disappearing Retry and explicit toast dismissal returned focus to Save. The selected native toast shell, authoritative store and protected source assets were preserved. Its prescribed placement can cover neighboring content, and broader inherited settings-layout limitations remain outside the bounded redesign scope.

`ba85c30226fb1eb1247fc85fbe21cdc6a0d5ee718d93494bac8e1980c506ef42`

The records enumerate the original capture paths, actual image-view request/response exports, separately viewed reviewer captures, behavior evidence and remaining unknowns. Raw failures and successful follow-ups remain retained. Isolation was instructional on a shared host; this review establishes bounded independent product findings, with no human usability, assistive-technology or natural-speed motion certification. Any later unblinding or repair disposition must remain separate from these frozen judgments.
